## Fastest route

The best way to reach me right now is through GitHub — [github.com/mattgross-dev](https://github.com/mattgross-dev). Open an issue or start a discussion on [this site's repository](https://github.com/mattgross-dev/mattgross-dev.github.io) and I'll see it.

## What to reach out about

- **Feedback** on anything on this site — the design, the writing, the projects.
- **Collaboration** on any of the projects on the [projects page](projects.qmd).
- **Conversation** about analytics, experimentation, or technical product leadership in general.

## What I'm less useful for

- Vendor pitches and SEO outreach.

I read everything, even when the reply is slow.
